scope: Subject identification for historical GPO engravings; cited comparison records are not tracing sources.

entries.identification: James Smithson in a Smithsonian Institution seal
entries.basis: The source shows a neoclassical profile bust within the Smithsonian Institution and Organized A.D. 1846 inscription. Smithsonian Institution Archives identifies the profile bust on its first seal as James Smithson.
entries.certainty: Subject identification inferred from the institutional record and observed composition; exact engraving lineage unestablished.

sources.title: First Smithsonian Seal, Smithsonian Institution Archives

entries.notes: The institutional record credits Edward Stabler for the original 1847 seal. That credit is not assigned to this GPO reproduction without evidence of its engraving lineage. The archive photograph was not used for tracing.

entries.identification: Compass shield, eagle and Vigilemus ut vigilatis motto; possible Bureau of Navigation association
entries.basis: Native scan confirms an eagle above a compass shield and the motto. Houghton Library catalogues a Bureau of Navigation bookplate with those same attributes and motto.
entries.certainty: Observed form and motto; institutional association inferred from matching catalogue description. Image-to-image confirmation remains open.

sources.title: United States Bureau of Navigation bookplate, Modern Books and Manuscripts, Houghton Library

entries.notes: Corrects an initial reading of a crown and a different motto. The public icon name describes visible forms and the transcribed motto without asserting an unverified agency attribution.

entries.identification: Agricultural allegory; unlettered composition related to the United States Agricultural Society seal
entries.basis: The 1897 GPO seal No. 34 has the same seated woman, raised wreath, cornucopia, drapery and encircling wreath, with the additional inscription UNITED STATES AGRICULTURAL SOCIETY and INS. 1852. The 1904 No. 39 lacks this inscription and remains a distinct complete composition.
entries.certainty: Observed comparison of both native historical impressions; does not attribute an institutional use to the unlettered variant.

sources.title: GPO 1897 specimen, printed page 94, seal No. 34

entries.notes: The public name describes the agricultural subject without assigning an unsupported artist or institutional commission.
